svg.title: FIFO waiting versus the T2 assured budget
svg.desc: 3050 Mb/s offered load · T2 SImax = 1 frame · Fixed packet arrivals within each seed FIFO wait is enqueue-to-load. Jitter is sample SD. Waits still in FIFO at the cutoff are censored. Dotted rings indicate limited tail support.

g.text: FIFO waiting versus the T2 assured budget
3050 Mb/s offered load · T2 SImax = 1 frame · Fixed packet arrivals within each seed
Points = seed mean | Whiskers = seed min–max | RR = one matched baseline per seed
FIFO wait is enqueue-to-load. Jitter is sample SD. Waits still in FIFO at the cutoff are censored. Dotted rings indicate limited tail support.
